thread:
Riley (Support): SableBank reported a sudden p95 and 5xx surge during their morning peak (09:45 UTC). They saw ~9% 503s and long tails.
Omar (Sales): SableBank is on a trial with latency SLAs. They want a fast mitigation. Looping @Fiona (PM).
Fiona (PM): Riley, paste route, model variant, region and sample payload. Any deploys around the timeframe?
Riley (Support): Route: /v1/generate (sablebank-prod). Model: gpt-legacy-quant. Seq ~520, client concurrency ~150. Snippet: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"gpt-legacy-quant","input":"~450 tokens"}` -> 503s. They noted regression right after the 09:40 deploy window.
deploybot: Rollout v2026.08.10.09.40 -> eu-west-2 pool-3
Ken (Eng): Telemetry: pod restarts and autoscaler activity on pool-3 at 09:41. Logs show GPU OOMs and kube OOMKills. The recent kernel scheduling tweak landed in that rollout; hypothesis: mem pressure on large KV caches under high concurrency.
Noor (Oncall): Confirmed OOM events and ingress queue growth. Several pods restarted and nginx p95 spiked.
Fiona (PM): Triage options: (1) Per-route fallback to an fp16 variant (fast). (2) Move SableBank to dedicated EU capacity (provisioning ~45m). (3) Global rollback of the heuristic (~1h). Need quick decision.
Omar (Sales): Customer prefers minimal quality impact. They asked for a canary fallback first if safe.
Ken (Eng): I'll push a route override canary: `PATCH /v1/routes/sablebank-prod {"model_override":"gpt-legacy-fp16","canary_requests":50,"canary_pct":10}`.
Noor (Oncall): I added alert: `sablebank_error_rate > 2% for 1m` -> page eng-oncall. Monitoring node OOM and ingress latency.
Riley (Support): Ran the canary. SableBank reports 50 requests: p95 320ms, errors 0.8% (was 9%). They want a 2-hour observation after full flip.
Fiona (PM): Decision: apply fallback and monitor 2h. Backlog items:
- P0 RCA (owner: Ken): reproduce memory spike and propose fix. Due 72h. Acceptance: repro + patch plan + perf benchmark.
- P1 Product spec: per-route auto-fallback under memory pressure (owner: Fiona). Due 2 sprints.
- P1 Ops: rollback runbook and customer mitigation checklist (owner: Noor). Due 5 days.
- P2 Customer comms & SLA impact calc (owner: Omar). Due 4h.
Ken (Eng): Created ticket RB-7012. Keeping override for 2h then evaluate. Logs and heap dumps attached to ticket.
deploybot: RB-7012 created by ken (Eng)
Fiona (PM): Customer acceptance criteria:
- SableBank p95 < 400ms and errors < 1% for 2 continuous hours
- RCA and mitigation plan delivered and scheduled fix planned
- Per-route fallback product spec added to roadmap
Omar (Sales): Sending hourly updates to SableBank and notifying finance about SLA risk.
Noor (Oncall): If error rate exceeds 2% we'll escalate and consider capacity move.
Ken (Eng): Promoting canary to 100% now.
Riley (Support): SableBank confirms full switch; p95 ~360ms and errors 0.5%. They've asked for hourly updates for the next 2 hours.
Fiona (PM): Thanks all. We'll track RB-7012 and create the product epic for auto-fallback. If the fallback fails we'll consider dedicated routing or rollback. :white_check_mark:
